comment: Secondary data source spreadsheet IDs, keyed by fiscal year. Two source types: 'state_head_dashboard' (aggregated plan/ordered/received per person per month) and 'register' (line-level secondary order rows). IDs sourced from mgmt_sources.json secondary_order_booking.files_by_year and state_head_dashboard.files_by_year. IMPORTANT: these are SECONDARY (distributor->retailer) figures and must never be summed with primary sale_line data.

frozen_registers.comment: All five FYs fully committed and Gate 2-verified. Sheet IDs preserved for audit reference only.
